rows.name: aHYPER Looping Vault
rows.description: An auto-looping vault for aHYPER, the Hyperithm delta-neutral vault, giving leveraged exposure to the underlying strategy. It inherits aHYPER's risks (delta-neutral execution, funding-fee volatility, counterparty, smart contract) and adds those of an isolated lending market: onchain lending risk, oracle or market misconfiguration, and collateral liquidation. The rate is driven by the spread between aHYPER's yield and the USDC borrowing cost, multiplied by the leverage factor, so a negative spread amplifies losses just as a positive one amplifies gains. Unwinding depends on USDC liquidity in the relevant Morpho market and on aHYPER redemption liquidity.

rows.name: Prime HELOC Loop
rows.description: Converts PYUSD into PRIME, supplies PRIME as collateral and borrows PYUSD to reach 5x target leverage (80% LTV) on the Morpho PRIME-PYUSD market. PRIME provides exposure to Figure's onchain private-credit infrastructure through Hastra, with yield generated from lending backed by Figure-originated HELOC collateral. Execution uses flashloans, and LTV may temporarily rise to 84% when PRIME trades below NAV before delevering back toward target.

rows.name: Wintermute Trading USD Coin
rows.description: An open-term undercollateralized credit market where Wintermute, a global algorithmic trading firm and OTC desk, borrows USDC directly from lenders. Unlike every other row here the rate is a fixed lender APR set by the market's parameters rather than a floating figure, and the position is a claim on a named borrower rather than on collateral: there is no overcollateralization behind it. Access is restricted on both deposit and withdrawal, with a 24-hour withdrawal cycle and a 48-hour grace period.
rows.rateBasis: Effective lender APR published by the market itself, not a measured onchain rate.
rows.tvlBasis: lender claims outstanding (rebasing 1:1 market token supply)

rows.name: Avantis USDC Vault
rows.description: The avUSDC vault is the counterparty to every trade on Avantis, so lenders earn a share of platform trading fees and, by construction, take the other side of trader profit and loss. Withdrawal fees are dynamic and rise when excess liquidity in the vault is low. Subject to drawdowns.

rows.name: Aave v3 USDC Market
rows.description: Lenders earn interest paid by borrowers who post collateral and take overcollateralized loans from the pool. The supply rate floats with utilization: the share of supplied USDC actually being borrowed. The deepest and longest-running venue in this report.
rows.rateBasis: Current supply rate, read from the Aave v3 Pool contract.

rows.name: Staked USDe
rows.description: The yield-bearing form of USDe, Ethena's synthetic dollar. USDe backing mixes staked ETH collateral, stablecoin and RWA reserves, and institutional lending positions. Yield comes from ETH staking rewards, funding rates on delta-hedged short perpetual futures, and interest on reserves. Deposited USDe converts to sUSDe, which appreciates as protocol earnings compound, which is why its share price is well above 1.

Used as collateral across Aave, Morpho, Kamino and Pendle, and deployed on Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Base and Plasma.
